messages:
sam: Quick sanity run on Veridian-11b quant candidates: int8 baseline, int6 tuned, int4 experimental. Ran 10k mixed-slice samples (long-QA, multi-paragraph summarization, short replies). Posting compact results + routing idea.

yara: TL;DR?

sam: TL;DR: int6 gives ~20% token cost savings vs int8 with small median latency wins, int4 gives ~36% token cost savings but shows significant quality regressions on multi-span QA and rerank tasks. Short summaries fine on int4.

li: numbers and sample split pls

sam: Sample sizes: 10k total (5k long-QA, 3k summarization, 2k short replies). Unit econ (hosted proxy): int8=$0.0090/k tok, int6=$0.0072/k tok (-20%), int4=$0.0058/k tok (-35.6%). p50 lat: int8=460ms, int6=410ms, int4=385ms. p95: int8=1040ms, int6=1065ms, int4=1115ms.

yara: quality metrics?

sam: main metrics: long-QA exact-match, reranker MAP. Mini-scorecard (csv style):

```
metric, int8, int6, int4
unit_cost($/k),0.0090,0.0072,0.0058
p50_latency(ms),460,410,385
p95_latency(ms),1040,1065,1115
longQA_exact(%),80.1,77.6,69.0
reranker_MAP(%),83.2,80.0,72.4
summarization_ROUGE_L,0.69,0.687,0.68
kv_cache_hit(long),0.64,0.59,0.51
```

li: int4 drop is large on longQA and rerank. Failure modes?

sam: int4 tends to lose low-entropy discriminative logits and flips near-ties in rerank candidates. For longQA it drops intermediate span recall — worse when prompts include multi-shot priming (>2 examples) or lots of near-duplicate passages.

ops-bot: smoke: veridian-int6-smoke OK (4832110200)

yara: recommendation? routing plan?

sam: Proposal: conservative hybrid routing. Default = int8. Allow int6 for short-summary and generator flows when estimated_out <= 300 AND feature_hint != "doc-qa"/"rerank". Allow int4 only for ultra-short non-QA calls (estimated_out <= 80) and when determinism not required. Guards: if examples_count >=2 OR concat_context >900 tokens -> force int8. Also add priming-guard: if prompt contains chain-of-thought markers -> force int8.

li: canary plan + monitoring?

sam: Canary: 72h on eligible traffic starting 10% for int6, 5% for int4 on ultra-short traffic. Monitor: long-QA exact-match by slice, reranker MAP, summarization ROUGE, unit-cost delta, p95 latency, top1 flip rate. Alert if long-QA exact drops >2% (int6) or >5% (int4) vs baseline. Capture failing queries for manual triage.

yara: infra note: on Dedicated we can bump batch size for int6 to amplify econ wins; for int4 be careful w/kv memory as more frequent evictions observed.

product: we'll add feature_hint to SDK and conservative defaults; opt-in flag for "cost-mode" will be available per app.

sam: Action items: eng-platform implement routing + priming guards; observability add canary dashboard + failing-query capture; product add SDK field + opt-in; eng-ml create follow-up re-eval after 72h canary. I'll upload CSV of borderline failures and the short runbook in #eng-ml.
